cookies.message: We use cookies to improve your experience on this site.

home.heroSubtitle: Clothing and accessories built to last, shaped to leave a mark.
home.promoBody: Use this code at checkout. Valid until the end of the month.
home.editorialBody: Every Reign piece starts with a choice: the fabric, the cut, the detail you don't see but always feel.

product.detailsBody: Materials chosen for their structure and longevity, reinforced seams and finishes checked one by one. Every piece is built to hold its shape season after season.
product.careBody: Favour gentle care: low-temperature washing or the cleaning method suited to the material, then air dry. Store your pieces away from direct light to preserve their colour.

items.question: What are the delivery times?
items.answer: Allow 2 to 4 business days in France, 4 to 7 business days for the UK.

items.question: Can I return an item?
items.answer: Yes, within 30 days of receipt, unworn and in its original packaging. See our Shipping & Returns page for details.

items.question: How do I know my size?
items.answer: Check our size guide, accessible from every product page and from the footer.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: We currently ship to France and the UK. More countries will follow.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: A confirmation email is sent after your order, including your order number.

about.title: About Reign
about.paragraph1: Reign was built on a simple conviction: clothing should hold its shape, literally and figuratively. Every collection starts from a silhouette, not a trend.
about.paragraph2: We work with a deliberately small number of materials and suppliers, to keep full control over the cut, construction, and finish of every piece.
about.paragraph3: Men, women, kids, accessories: one standard runs through every category — every piece is built to last, and built to command attention.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: A question about an order, a collection, or a partnership? Write to us.

shippingReturns.title: Shipping & Returns
shippingReturns.shippingBody: Orders ship within 24 to 48 business hours. Estimated delivery: 2 to 4 business days in France, 4 to 7 business days for the UK.
shippingReturns.returnsBody: Returns are accepted within 30 days of receipt, unworn and in original packaging.
shippingReturns.exchangesBody: For a size or color exchange, return the item and place a new order — your refund is triggered as soon as the return is received.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: All elements present on the Site (text, images, logos, illustrations, layout, source code) are protected by intellectual property law and remain the exclusive property of Reign SAS or its partners, unless otherwise stated. Any reproduction, representation, or use, in whole or in part, without prior written authorization, is prohibited and may result in legal action.

sections.heading: Personal data
body: The processing of personal data collected on the Site is described in detail in our Privacy Policy, accessible from the footer.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: The Site uses cookies necessary for its operation (language and currency preferences, cart contents). To learn more about their use and your rights, see our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Applicable law and disputes
body: These legal notices are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute and failing an amicable resolution, French courts shall have sole jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Purpose and scope
body: These Terms of Sale govern the sale of products concluded remotely between Reign SAS ("the Seller") and any individual making a purchase on the Site ("the Customer"). Any order placed on the Site implies unreserved acceptance of these Terms of Sale, in the version in force on the day of the order.

sections.heading: Products
body: The products offered for sale are those presented on the Site on the day of consultation, within the limit of available stock. Reign reserves the right to modify its product range at any time.

sections.heading: Price
body: Prices are shown in euros (€) or pounds sterling (£) depending on the currency selected by the Customer, all taxes included, excluding delivery fees. Delivery fees are specified before the order is finally confirmed. Reign reserves the right to change its prices at any time; products are invoiced based on the rates in effect at the time the order is confirmed.

sections.heading: Order
body: The Customer selects the products of their choice, adds them to their cart, enters their delivery details, and proceeds to payment. An order summary (products, quantities, prices, delivery fees) is shown before final confirmation. An order confirmation is sent by email to the address provided by the Customer.

sections.heading: Payment
body: Payment is made online, at the time of ordering, via one of the methods offered on the Site (credit card, Stripe, Genius Pay). The order is considered final once payment is confirmed by the relevant payment provider. No payment data is retained by Reign.

sections.heading: Delivery
body: Reign currently ships to France and the United Kingdom. Estimated delivery times are 2 to 4 business days in France and 4 to 7 business days in the United Kingdom, from the date of shipment. See our Shipping & Returns page for full details.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal
body: In accordance with Articles L221-18 et seq. of the French Consumer Code, the Customer has a period of 14 full days from receipt of their order to exercise their right of withdrawal, without having to justify a reason or pay a penalty, except for return shipping costs.

sections.heading: Returns and refunds
body: Items must be returned unworn, unwashed, and in their original packaging, within 30 days of receipt. Refunds are issued via the same payment method used for the order, within **to be completed** days after receipt and inspection of the returned item.

sections.heading: Legal warranties
body: Products sold benefit from the legal warranty of conformity (Articles L217-3 et seq. of the French Consumer Code) and the warranty against hidden defects (Articles 1641 et seq. of the French Civil Code), without prejudice to the provisions taken by Reign under its returns policy.

sections.heading: Liability
body: Reign cannot be held liable for non-performance of the contract in the event of stock shortage or product unavailability, force majeure, total or partial disruption or strike affecting postal services or means of transport, or fault on the part of the Customer.

sections.heading: Personal data
body: Data collected as part of order processing is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Applicable law and disputes
body: These Terms of Sale are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, the Customer may resort to conventional mediation or any other alternative dispute resolution method. Failing an amicable resolution, French courts shall have sole jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Data controller
body: The controller responsible for processing personal data collected on the Site is Reign SAS, **address to be completed**, contact: contact@reign.example.

sections.heading: Data collected
body: As part of using the Site, we collect: identification and delivery data provided when placing an order (name, postal address, email), data submitted via the contact form (name, email, message), language and currency preferences, and the contents of the cart and favorites — the latter three being stored locally in the Customer's browser and not transmitted to our servers.

sections.heading: Purposes of processing
body: This data is used to: process and deliver orders, provide after-sales service and respond to contact requests, personalize the display of the Site (language, currency), and comply with our legal and accounting obligations.

sections.heading: Legal basis
body: Processing is based, depending on the case, on: performance of the sales contract (order processing), the Customer's consent (locally saved preferences), and Reign's legitimate interest (service improvement, responding to contact requests).

sections.heading: Data recipients
body: Data is intended for Reign SAS's internal departments as well as its technical service providers (hosting: **to be completed**; payment: Stripe, Genius Pay), strictly to the extent necessary to process orders. No payment data is processed or retained directly by Reign.

sections.heading: Retention period
body: Order-related data is retained for as long as necessary to process it, then archived in accordance with applicable legal and accounting obligations (**exact duration to be completed**). Preferences stored locally (language, currency, cart, favorites) remain on the Customer's device until manually cleared from their browser.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to, and port your data. You may exercise these rights at any time by contacting us at contact@reign.example, specifying your identity.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: The Site uses cookies strictly necessary for its operation (remembering language, currency, and cart contents). No third-party analytics or advertising cookies are used at this stage (**to be confirmed before production launch**).

sections.heading: Security
body: Reign implements reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or disclosure.

sections.heading: Complaints
body: If, after contacting us, you believe your rights are not being respected, you may file a complaint with the French Data Protection Authority (CNIL): www.cnil.fr.
